verdict.rationale: Perplexity is operated through natural language at its core. Users can type or speak questions, ask from the toolbar, and follow up in threads (docs-11, docs-15, docs-39). Its Assistant drafts emails, schedules appointments and books reservations (docs-9), and Computer carries out multi-step tasks, including browser actions, from natural-language requests (docs-30, docs-38). One hands-on report says Computer often fails to trigger or stalls (comm-7), but this concerns the reliability of one agentic feature, not natural-language operation itself, which a user confirms works for everyday use (comm-12). Missing for 10: independent corroboration that Assistant actions like scheduling and booking work, and reliable hands-on evidence for Computer's task execution.
